title: Study of 3D Ultrasound for Support of Hemodialysis Cannulation
official: Study of 3D Ultrasound for Support of Hemodialysis Cannulation
summary: This study is a prospective, single arm, multi-center two-stage feasibility study designed to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of the use of the EchoMap device to assist in traditional methods of AV fistula cannulation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \> 18 years but \< 85 years of age at the time of informed consent
* Subjects who have received an upper extremity autologous arteriovenous fistula, which has been cleared for at least 1-needle cannulation
* Subjects have a fistula with a history of miscannulation or requires an expert cannulator or have a new fistula that has not previously been cannulated
* Subject is able to sign informed consent and able to participate in all testing associated with this clinical investigation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \<18 years old
* Subject unable to sign informed consent.
* Subject is breastfeeding, pregnant, or plans to become pregnant
* Prisoner or Subject from vulnerable populations as defined in 45 CFR 46.
* Subjects that do not have a clinically mature upper extremity AV fistula that is cleared for at least 1-needle cannulation
* Subjects that do not have a fistula with a history of miscannulation or requires an expert cannulator or do not have a new fistula that has not previously been cannulated
* Subjects that are cannulated through a buttonhole technique
* Subjects with a history of poor compliance with the dialysis protocol
* Subjects who have suffered an access related injury or underwent access related intervention in the last 2 weeks
